q1_issues.issue: The sealed complement drops the clause's subject "this" and the copular equation "this was the first time ..." entirely, re-expressing it as an Ordinal tag on the rejection event, so the identification of the referred-to situation with that first rejection is lost.
Ordinal is used with the reject event as both the ranked entity and its own scale, whereas the instruction set's form ranks an entity on an associated event's ordering ((Ordinal priya 1 respond)).

q2_gaps: "this was the first / Nth time (that) S" — a clausal ordinal-occasion equative; the Ordinal rule covers only an ordinal NP ranking an entity, not a copular clause equating a discourse referent with the first occasion of an event type
notes: The matrix say-as-attitude (Experiencer holder, sealed Theme, non-factive so nothing of P at top level), the news_release compound with its genus, the bare (Weekday thursday) term, and the In-oblique for "in a news release" all follow the instruction set.
